title: Binance Margin Adds New USDC Pairs - 2024-07-09
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin has added new USDC trading pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin.  Cross Margin Isolated Margin New Trading Pairs FET/USDC ,  FLOKI/USDC ,  NOT/USDC ,  ZRO/USDC FET/USDC ,  FLOKI/USDC ,  NOT/USDC ,  ZRO/USDC Explore Binance Margin Now!
